2. The position of a particle moving in the xy-plane is given by the parametric equations x(t) = t3 - 3t² and
y(t) = 12t - 3t². At which of the following points (x, y) is the particle at rest?
(A) (-4, 12)
(B) (-3, 6)
(C) (-2, 9)
(D) (0, 0)
(E) (3, 4)
